sentences.text: Hodie dies Dominica est. Dies Dominica dies Dei est. Omnes ad ecclesiam eunt.
sentences.english: Today is Sunday. Sunday is God's day. All go to church.

sentences.text: Martha ad ecclesiam it. Anna et Lucius ad ecclesiam eunt. Marcus et Samuel quoque ad ecclesiam eunt.
sentences.english: Martha goes to church. Anna and Lucius go to church. Marcus and Samuel go to church too.

sentences.text: Ecclesia non longe est. Ecclesia magna est, et multi homines in ecclesia sunt.
sentences.english: The church is not far. The church is big, and many people are in the church.

sentences.text: In ecclesia homines Deum laudant. Homines Deum amant. Homines Deo gratias agunt.
sentences.english: In church people praise God. People love God. People give thanks to God.

sentences.text: Homines audiunt, et orant, et cantant.
sentences.english: People listen, and pray, and sing.

sentences.text: Sacerdos quoque in ecclesia est. Sacerdos Deum laudat. Sacerdos dicit: Pax vobis!
sentences.english: The priest is in the church too. The priest praises God. The priest says: Peace to you!

sentences.text: Omnes dicunt: Deo gratias!
sentences.english: All say: Thanks be to God!

sentences.text: Post ecclesiam Martha in foro est. Martha panem vendit.
sentences.english: After church Martha is in the market. Martha sells bread.

sentences.text: Samuel ad ecclesiam venit. Marthae dicit: Salve!
sentences.english: Samuel comes to the church. He says to Martha: Hello!

sentences.text: Salve, Martha! Hodie ad ecclesiam venio.
sentences.english: Hello, Martha! Today I come to church.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bene! Hodie bonum est.
sentences.english: Good! It is good today.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ubi est Anna? Estne in ecclesia?
sentences.english: Where is Anna? Is she in church?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Anna ibi est! Et Lucius ibi est.
sentences.english: Anna is there! And Lucius is there too.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Et Marcus? Ubi est puer?
sentences.english: And Marcus? Where is the boy?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Marcus hic est. Ecce Marcus! Ibi cantat.
sentences.english: Marcus is here. Look, Marcus! He is singing there.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ego Deum laudo! Libenter in ecclesia sum.
sentences.english: I praise God! I am gladly in church.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Et ego Deum laudo. Gratias Deo ago.
sentences.english: And I praise God. I give thanks to God.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Martha, tu quoque oras?
sentences.english: Martha, do you pray too?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Oro, et Deo gratias ago. Libenter oro, libenter canto.
sentences.english: I pray, and I give thanks to God. I gladly pray, I gladly sing.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Lucius et Anna in ecclesia sunt. Lucius Samuelem videt.
sentences.english: Lucius and Anna are in the church. Lucius sees Samuel.

sentences.text: Salve, Samuel! Quomodo vales?
sentences.english: Hello, Samuel! How are you?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Bene valeo, Luci. Et tu? Quomodo vales?
sentences.english: I am well, Lucius. And you? How are you?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bene valeo, sed fessus sum. Anna quoque fessa est.
sentences.english: I am well, but I am tired. Anna is tired too.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Hodie in valetudinario non laboro. Hic sum, et bene est.
sentences.english: Today I do not work at the clinic. I am here, and it is well.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Sacerdos dicit: Pax vobis! Omnes dicunt: Deo gratias!
sentences.english: The priest says: Peace to you! All say: Thanks be to God!

sentences.text: Post ecclesiam Samuel in domo Marthae est. Panem edunt et lac bibunt.
sentences.english: After church Samuel is in Martha's house. They eat bread and drink milk.

sentences.text: Martha Deum amat, et omnes homines Deum amant.
sentences.english: Martha loves God, and all people love God.
